description: Perpetuals account state for one Hyperliquid wallet address -- two separate flags (account_has_balance: non-zero account value, idle dust included; account_has_open_perp_positions: a position is open or notional / margin is non-zero), then account value, total notional, margin used, withdrawable, cross-maintenance margin, and every open perp position (coin, signed size where negative = short, entry price, position value, unrealized PnL, ROE, liquidation price, leverage, margin used, cumulative funding). Public on-chain data, keyless. Use for "what is this Hyperliquid wallet's position / margin / leverage". Returns aggregates first, positions last. e.g. {address:"0x31dea2516beee92135b96f464eeec3cf292a13f2"}.
name: hyperliquid_account_state
